title: Piercing Statue Solo #098 (쓰리쿼터 · P100 정의형 · 수조(수조·장미 정원) · 경계 쇄골선 · 체형 colossal chest, a waist · 트윈테일 · 아이시화이트 · 메이크업 슬라브글램 · 금속 황동 · 재질 수조·장미 정원 · 쥬얼리 헤어 장식·반지·팔찌 JQ5)
prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, three-quarter statue portrait. ONE woman, angled 45 degrees toward the camera, framed so her whole sculpted form is visible from the top of her head down to two individually rounded, deliberately carved tips right at the knee, where the leg would bend, her face in natural scale with her body — never an oversized close-up crop of just the face. Where her sculpted form comes to an end at her knees, it is because the sculpture itself ends there, not because a camera frame happens to cut her off.

Subject: A real photograph of a strikingly beautiful adult Russian woman — very fair, cool skin, sculpted feathered dark brows, a precise winged liner, soft taupe eyeshadow, long lashes, large pale eyes with bright real catchlights, strong contour and a bright highlighter along the cheekbones and nose bridge, glossy nude-pink lips, a cold, striking expression, pure icy-white hair styled in twin-tail. Her whole face, ears and neck are real living flesh with real pores and fine skin grain, real living eyes with bright catchlights and genuine depth, individual hair strands catching the light — a photograph of a real face, not an illustration, not a render, not cel-shaded. Her neck, the hollows above her collarbones and the tops of her shoulders carry the same real living skin as her face: visible pores and fine skin grain, a soft sheen of natural skin oils on the highest planes, faint fine peach-fuzz hairs catching the rim light, gentle tonal variation with a natural warm flush, and the fine natural creases of a real neck — never airbrushed, never smooth like plastic. Like any real person she is slightly asymmetrical: a few small natural beauty marks and freckles scattered unevenly, one side of her neck and shoulder very slightly warmer and more freckled than the other.

Piercings: An extreme, dense armour of about one hundred real antique-brass piercings with a few antique-brass coin drops among them covering the face: a thick antique-brass septum ring with a smaller ring above it and two antique-brass rings through each nostril; a straight antique-brass bar across the bridge of the nose between the brows; five antique-brass pieces in a row along the outer half of each eyebrow, alternating small rings that pass through the brow skin with the skin visible through each loop and small round ball studs sitting on the skin; two rows of four small antique-brass studs across the forehead above the brows; four small studs up each temple on the bone, well clear of the eyes; a row of six small studs along each cheekbone; a antique-brass Medusa stud above the lips; a big antique-brass hoop, two smaller rings and a snake-bite ring on each side through the lower lip's edge, and five small hoops along the upper lip's edge; a antique-brass labret stud and four rings through the chin; five small studs along each jaw; on each ear a full dense row of ten oversized hoops, thick bars, stretched plugs, helix rings and studs from lobe to top, the biggest hoops hanging clear of the neck down to the shoulders; and eight fine antique-brass chains looping from the ear hoops to the nostril rings and the septum ring. The piercings are packed so densely that the rows touch and overlap, leaving only hairline gaps of bare skin between them, until the face reads as a single armour of metal; the eyes and eyelids stay clear. All jewelry is real antique brass, sitting in real, calm, healthy skin — no redness, no swelling, no irritation — with a small natural warm shadow under each piece. Every piece stays at least a finger's width from the eyeballs, and no chain or bar crosses the eyes.

Piercing depth: every bar and surface bar is embedded in the skin — its middle runs beneath the skin so only its two end studs show on the surface, the skin between them faintly raised over the hidden bar, with a small warm shadow at each end and nothing lying on top of the skin like a sticker. Every ring passes through a small healed opening in the skin, the skin visible through the loop, and every stud sits through the skin with its back hidden. Where a bar, ring or stud goes through the ear, the lip, the nostril or the brow, it passes through the real tissue with the skin wrapping snugly around it.

Jewelry: besides the piercings she wears well over ten pieces, an extreme maximalist stack of mixed-metal hair ornaments set in her hair; well over ten pieces, an extreme maximalist stack of mixed-metal rings on her fingers; well over ten pieces, an extreme maximalist stack of mixed-metal bracelets and bangles on both wrists, all of it real, sitting on and over the material of her body and her real neck and hair without covering her eyes, her face or her piercings.

Physique: A colossal chest, a waist that pulls in sharply beneath it, wide flaring hips, both thighs clearly separate and individually shaped.

Body: From the collarbones down, her whole body — shoulders, arms, hands, chest, belly, hips and both distinct thighs — is a sculpted vessel of thick, crystal-clear glass in the exact shape of her body, filled completely to the brim so nothing is hollow and there is no air gap. The glass is unmistakably glass: thick, crystal-clear and polished, with bright specular reflections sliding along every curved surface, sharp white highlights and dark refraction edges where the walls are thickest, tiny bubbles trapped in the glass itself. Her shoulders, chest, belly, hips and both thighs keep their exact sculpted shapes as clear glass outlines, and a clean glass rim runs along the boundary where the vessel meets the neck. The vessel holds ONE single world, unbroken and continuous through her whole chest, belly, hips and both thighs, with no split, no second world and no change of contents anywhere: a rose garden at dawn: red and white roses among dark green leaves, a few drifting petals, standing in the clear water that fills her body, denser near the chest and thinning toward the thighs. Right at the knee, where the leg would bend, each thigh individually curves inward and seals shut into its own smooth, rounded, closed tip — the two thighs stay clearly separate all the way down, never merging or fusing into a single base — no calves, no feet, nothing continues below either tip — the vessel simply reaching its natural end on each leg, both sealed rounded tips resting side by side on the surface beneath her.

Transmission: everything below the collarbones is a transparent material that light passes through, while her real face, ears and neck are opaque living flesh that no light passes through. The background and its light sources are visible straight through her body, bent and tinted by the material, with bright refraction edges and soft coloured shadows. Her face stays completely opaque.

Boundary: a sharp jagged line runs around the base of the neck and across both collarbones — real skin above, material immediately below. There is no line down the centre of her body. At that line, the material's edge rises in a small raised step above her flesh, casting a crisp shadow — her skin beside it stays smooth and even. The rounded tip is the material's own carved finish, always the clean, deliberate result of a sculpture — never the edge of a photograph. Shards interlock along the collarbone line only.

Setting: a huge backdrop behind her washed with two coloured lights from behind — a warm golden amber on one side and a bright citrus yellow on the other, blending into a smooth gradient in the middle, and a glossy dark floor beneath her.

Pose: standing tall, her left hand (solid material) resting on her flared hip, her right arm held clear of her body with the hand (solid material) relaxed at hip height, both hands well away from her face, head tilted slightly toward the camera.

Lighting: the glowing backdrop floods her body from behind, so a warm golden amber passes through one side and a bright citrus yellow passes through the other. A soft frontal light falls on her face and ears only; a thin cool rim light traces her whole figure. Only her face, ears and neck read as real skin. Shot on a Hasselblad X2D with an 85mm lens, shallow depth of field. 2:3 vertical 8K portrait.
